rationales: A see-saw does not make continuous rotation in one direction.
Its motion is not circular motion as a whole.
A see-saw moves to and fro about a mean position, so it is vibratory motion.
Its motion is not random because it follows a repeated pattern.
The resultant of all forces acting on a body is called the net force.
Friction is only one possible force acting on a body.
Gravitational force is only one possible force acting on a body.
Force is the general interaction, while the resultant is specifically the net force.
Inertia depends on mass: greater mass means greater inertia.
Force can change motion, but it is not what inertia is related to.
Weight is the gravitational force on a body, not its measure of inertia.
Energy is not the measure of a body's inertia.
The value of sin 30° is not 0.15.
The value 0.866 is approximately sin 60°.
The value 0.707 is approximately sin 45°.
The value of sin 30° is 0.5.
10 m s⁻² is approximately the value of g on Earth, not the Moon.
The Moon's gravitational acceleration is approximately 1.62 m s⁻².
3.7 m s⁻² is approximately the value of g on Mars.
3.9 m s⁻² is not the value of g on the Moon.
Energy is the capacity to do work, not the rate of doing work.
Torque is the turning effect of a force.
Force is not the rate of doing work.
Power is the rate of doing work.
Newton's laws do not state the pressure-transmission principle used by a hydraulic press.
A hydraulic press works according to Pascal's law.
Archimedes' principle describes buoyancy in fluids.
Hooke's law describes the relation between force and extension within the elastic limit.
Watt is a unit of power.
Kelvin is a unit of temperature.
Joule is a unit of heat energy.
Ampere is a unit of electric current.
273 °C is not absolute zero.
373 °C is not absolute zero.
Absolute zero is approximately −273 °C.
0 °C is the freezing point of water, not absolute zero.
A measuring cylinder is not used to measure mass.
A measuring cylinder is not used to measure area.
A measuring cylinder measures the volume of a liquid.
A measuring cylinder measures volume, not merely the liquid's level.
A pendulum does not move along a straight path.
A clock pendulum moves repeatedly to and fro, so its motion is vibratory.
A pendulum swings about a pivot rather than rotating continuously.
A clock pendulum's repeated motion is not random.
P = ma gives force, not momentum.
P = dt is not the formula for momentum.
P = F × d represents work, not momentum.
Momentum is the product of mass and velocity: P = mv.
Centripetal force acts toward the centre and keeps a body moving in a circle.
Magnetic force can act in some situations but is not the general force that causes circular motion.
Gravitational force can provide centripetal force in some cases, but it is not the general name for it.
Centrifugal force is an apparent outward force in a rotating frame, not the inward force that maintains circular motion.
10000 kg m⁻³ is far greater than the density of water.
The density of water is approximately 1000 kg m⁻³.
100 kg m⁻³ is one-tenth of the density of water.
10 kg m⁻³ is much less than the density of water.
Torque has SI unit newton metre (N·m).
N is the unit of force, not torque.
N m⁻² is the unit of pressure.
N m⁻¹ is not the SI unit of torque.
